title: Solid Mechanics: Equilibrium, Stress, Strain, and Material Limits
subject: Solid Mechanics
description: Move from a free-body diagram to internal load, stress, strain, deformation, material limits, and an engineering design check.
outcomes: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to construct accurate free-body diagrams and apply translational and rotational equilibrium to solve for unknown forces and moments
By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to calculate internal normal and shear stresses, relate them to normal strain and elastic modulus, and interpret stress-strain data
By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to perform a complete axial-member calculation with correct units, evaluate yielding and fracture limits, and apply safety factors
